s: Which of the following is false with regards to socio-religious and economic conditions during the Satavahana rule?
o: The Satavahana rulers followed Hinduism but some of their queens patronised Buddhism
The women were looked down upon
There was a flourishing maritime trade
x:
The statement is incorrect because women enjoyed a respectable position in Satavahana society. Evidence includes: • Queens such as Gautami Balashri and Naganika issued inscriptions and made religious donations. • Satavahana rulers commonly used matronymics, identifying themselves by their mothers' names (e.g., Gautamiputra Satakarni). The remaining statements correctly describe Satavahana society.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
n: Satavahana Society – Women enjoyed a respectable status.
